subject: general
question: For which of the following calipers, a screw and nut are provided for opening and closing the caliper legs?
solution:
The correct answer is __Spring Joint Calipers.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Spring joint calipers__ have a screw and nut mechanism for opening and closing the caliper legs.
 
• This mechanism allows precise adjustments for measurement and layout.
 
• They are commonly used in metalworking and engineering for accurate measurements.
 
• Unlike firm joint calipers, spring joint calipers have a spring that ensures smooth operation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Leg and Point Calipers:**

 
 
• These calipers are used for measuring distances and transferring measurements.
 
• They do not have a screw and nut mechanism.
 
 
 
• **Simple Calipers:**
 
 
• These are basic calipers without any special adjustment mechanisms.
 
 
 
• **Firm Joint Calipers:**
 
 
• Firm joint calipers are adjusted by manually setting the legs to the required position.
 
• They do not feature a spring or screw mechanism.
